'''Nick Boll''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 San Diego Comic-Con Open]] in July 2001 with JP EV-9D9 droid draining with podracing, according to Alan Jern's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2695">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-22-comicon-2001-scrub-reportd2695/ comicon-2001-scrub-report], DeckTech (Alan "DrObiwannabe" Jern, 22 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-22-comicon-2001-scrub-reportd2695/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
